rows: A good hand gets both people home. Show me the hand first, then we talk about the rest.
Brawling is fine when it has a reason. I want to see the reason.
A risk is a lesson with a test attached. Let me set the test.
Slowing down can be sensible. Plenty of people need to learn to do it properly.
The people deserve work that is done carefully and well. That is what I want to give them.
Short version: the standard is the standard, and I am not moving it.
I know what good looks like, and I can show it to you.
Look at the stance. It is what I teach. Copy it, then improve it.
You say technique. Show me one safe hold you can do again tomorrow.
Strikes are fine in the right place. I want control, not noise.
A risk without a plan is a mistake waiting for a date.
Stalling is not my teaching. Move, and show me you can.
The people want work they can respect. Give them that, and they will remember it.
You talk about being among the best. Good. Then act like it in the ring.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good. Now show me the discipline behind it.
I have watched your {strength} carefully, and I can see where the discipline is missing.
You kept calm. Good, that is the right start.
Fair. That is the standard I was hoping you would meet.
I could be stern about that. I would rather show you the lesson.
One fall. Clean and safe. Keep me down and I will say it was well done.
On the mat we will go slowly and check each step. Stay with me.
Grounded or standing, the standard applies to both of us.
Stay in front of me. I want to see your technique under pressure.
Good answer. That is the kind of answer I can build on.
You have not answered. Take your time and answer it properly.
Fair. We will keep the standard in sight.
I accept that. We will settle it with a proper test.
I will wrestle this match with care and finish with control.
My approach is patient and safe. You will see it on the night.
Whatever happens, I want you to leave knowing what you did right.
It is not finished. There is one more lesson left.
I have one more test for you. You will see it when the bell goes.
